description: 【北海道】航空レーザーデータ(H29_海岸町・共栄町地区地域防災対策総合治山) [sediment-control and coastal defences and fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 水産林務部. 根室振興局林務課 羅臼町 座標参照系 EPSG2455 JGD2000平面直角座標系13系. Coverage: Kaigan-cho and Kyoei-cho district, Hokkaido, Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 水産林務部. Its tags are 3次元点群データ, DEM, 北海道, 航空レーザー. It offers 7 resource(s) in jpeg, kml, zip. The portal shows 2024-10-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
